California Secretary of State file number (12 digits)
Line 1. Total qualifying wages. See instructions
Line 3. Pass-through Prison Inmate Labor Credit(s) from Schedule K-1 (100S, 541, 565, or 568). See instructions
Line 4. Credit carryover from 2024. See instructions
Line 5. Total available Prison Inmate Labor Credit. Add line 2, line 3, and line 4
Line 6a. Credit claimed. Enter the amount of the credit claimed on the current year tax return. See instructions. (Do not include any assigned credit claimed on form FTB 3544, Part B.)
Line 6b. Total credit assigned. Enter the total amount from form FTB 3544, Part A, column (g). If you are not a corporation, enter 0. See instructions
Line 6c. Credit amount to be elected as refundable in future years. See instructions
Line 7. Carryover of the disallowed credit amount to future years. Add lines 6a, 6b, and 6c, subtract the result from line 5. See instructions
